name: Clipboard Tools
description: Read, write, inspect and clear the clipboard from agent tools and workflow nodes, through the host's permission-guarded clipboard API.
author: cognia-next

permissionJustifications.clipboard:read: Lets the agent and workflow nodes read the current clipboard text and image (clipboard_status, clipboard_read_image, Read clipboard text).
permissionJustifications.clipboard:write: Lets the agent and workflow nodes replace or empty the clipboard (clipboard_write_text, clipboard_clear, Write clipboard text, Clear clipboard).

tools.name: clipboard_status
tools.description: Report what the clipboard holds (text and/or image) and return the current clipboard text.

tools.name: clipboard_read_image
tools.description: Read the image currently on the clipboard and return it as an image the model can see. Desktop only; a browser shell has no image clipboard.

tools.name: clipboard_write_text
tools.description: Replace the clipboard contents with the given text.

text.description: The text to place on the clipboard.

browser.reason: Text read/write works through the browser Clipboard API (a user gesture may be required); image read/write and image detection are desktop-only.

mobile.reason: Clipboard read/write is restricted in the mobile WebView (no synchronous read; user-gesture required); image clipboard is unavailable.

en.manifest.name: Clipboard Tools

en.workflow.nodes.action.readText.label: Read clipboard text
